responsibility: Defines lowering for items that appear inside Rust extern blocks. It translates AST external static and external function declarations into HIR external-item nodes, lowering visibility, generic parameters, parameter and return types, variadic markers, and placeholder where-clause structure, then registers each lowered declaration under its parent extern block in the HIR mapping tables. This file is narrower than general item lowering: it owns foreign-item declarations rather than top-level Rust items or the extern block container itself.
